name: ui-craft
description: Consolidated UI engineering team plugin: design, review, improvement and performance optimization for any UI surface (web, iOS, Android, desktop), with deep TypeScript/React/Tailwind v4 coverage plus Apple and Android review overlays. Ten specialists (architect, visual reviewer, anti-slop auditor, accessibility, motion, responsive, perf engineer, TypeScript engineer, verifier, team lead), pinned to the coding/review model tier at dispatch. Four user-invoked skills: design-ui (new UI from scratch), review-ui (adaptive specialist review with delta reporting against a review ledger), improve-ui (full team pass plus prioritized fix plan), optimize-ui (Core Web Vitals audit). Backed by a fully self-contained reference library: 57 files across 12 domains covering fluid and intrinsic sizing, breakpoints versus container queries, zoom and adaptive postures, task flows and journeys, forms and error recovery, navigation and information architecture, states and feedback, WCAG 2.2, OKLCH and APCA color, fluid typography, motion, Tailwind v4, shadcn, component and state architecture, Core Web Vitals, TypeScript 6/7 typing with the TS7 type gate, chart palettes, density and economy, and a 150-plus-tell anti-AI catalogue. Produces severity-tagged findings (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/TASTE) with evidence citations, confidence classes and concrete remediation, against one canonical finding template. Ships a labeled regression corpus (21 fixtures) with a recall- and precision-gated scoring harness and its own 23-case selftest, a CI gate producing GREEN/YELLOW/RED verdict artifacts with a 28-case selftest, and a review ledger for run-over-run delta reports. Read-only by default; the orchestrator applies findings only on explicit user approval.
